title: Cartographie du risque de fièvre jaune et vaccination antiamarile recommandée pour les voyageurs : projet de résolution proposé par l’Argentine

sections.title: Front matter

summary.text: Opening of a French-language Executive Board draft resolution (EB136/CONF./10, 2015) proposed by Argentina on yellow fever risk mapping and vaccination for travellers. It recalls the updated IHR Annex 7 stating that a single yellow fever vaccine dose gives lifelong protection and that vaccination certificates remain valid for life.

sections.title: INVITE INSTAMMENT les États Membres :

summary.text: Operative paragraphs of the French-language draft resolution on yellow fever, urging Member States to state whether they will accept lifelong certificate validity and asking the Director-General to publish a list of accepting countries and set up a scientific advisory group on yellow fever risk mapping.
